Nina: Heads up — YVR leaf-switch flapping since 01:14 PDT, provisioning stalls hitting the H100 top-up. Vendor pickup at 06:00 PDT.
Ravi: Is this a single-leaf or fabric-wide?

Diego: If we miss the pickup window vendor will push to next available slot (+6 business days). Not great.
Arjun (NexaSupply): We can hold shipment at origin up to 5 hours. AWB: NX-550881. If you need an air-split for 8 urgent units thereis a $1.8k expedite. Sea split adds ~48-72h customs delay.
Nina: Can we route those stalled VMs to SEA pool temporarily? Tradeoff: added latency but keeps customer SLAs intact.
Ravi: We can, but need to tag nodes and drop scheduler TTLs. I'll do a fast pool tag and DNS TTL drop.
OncallBot: ALERT: netlink-flap detected on yvr-leaf-5  01:15 PDT  ticket INC-2026-321 created.
Diego: Quick mitigation: enable local KV cache fallback and reduce batch windows for provisioning. May salvage ~60% of starts.
Nina: Pushed cache fallback. Monitoring 5m window.
Ravi: Update: cache fallback recovered 9/14 nodes. 5 remain queued.
Diego: If under 6 remaining at 05:45 we'll avoid split. Otherwise signal to Arjun for 05:50-air split.
